name: grid-pattern
title: Grid Pattern
blurb: Static SVG grid with optional square highlights.
description: SVG pattern overlay that renders a thin grid. Can highlight specific grid cells by passing an array of [x,y] coordinates.
use_when: A lightweight, static grid background that needs selective highlighting via the squares prop.
avoid_when: Heavy highlighting — each square is a separate SVG rect element, so hundreds of highlighted squares may impact…
a11y: Marked aria-hidden with pointer-events-none; purely decorative overlay.
